_doc: SSOT registry of every desired state and bug fix with unique IDs. Pre-flight checker (check_healing_coverage.py) cross-references annotations in healing source files against this registry. Adding a new fix: (1) add ID here, (2) add annotation to each mechanism source that implements it, (3) make test gates it.

native_agent.description: Native Kotlin agent handling co-monitor, Tailscale relaunch, and catastrophic Shizuku repair without a11y UI dependencies

fleet_health.description: Mac launchd fleet-health observation and auto-heals (native-agent restart, HD8 stack, ET reconcile, repair restart)
